TOP RIGHT: one broadleaf shrub twig with 8 glossy green pointed leaves, organic shape, natural varied green values and vein detail. Photoreal botanical scan quality, diffuse neutral soft lighting, no hard cast shadows, no pot, no ground, no black background, no glow, no stylization. Every plant fully visible including base. Intended alpha-tested curved 3D foliage cards in a nighttime realistic cyberpunk Japanese garden, abundant rich green foliage.
